Pending authority. These scripts have not executed model inference.

Parent must create `.agent/third-trial-authority.json` only after the user answers:
`started_at`, `deadline_utc`, `max_attempts: 30`, `budget_usd: 3`, and
`cloud_allowed: true` only when OpenRouter text inference is explicitly approved.
The deadline must be at most 30 minutes after started_at.

Run `uv run --no-sync python .agent/run_third_trial.py` for the first four calls:
Faros and the existing synthetic true-probability case, each using the actual
current site insight prompt on Qwen3.6:27b and Sonnet5.5 if cloud is authorized.
Local-only authority runs two calls. Do not treat these controls as a full baseline.

Support API: `ThirdTrial()`, `config_for('ollama'|'openrouter')`, and
`bounded_call(config, workload_tag, prompt, **kwargs)`. Wire canonical pipeline
module call seams to bounded_call. All phases run sequentially and resume the same
atomic receipt. Do not launch parallel writers or repeat a submitted interrupted
call automatically. Inspect incomplete submissions first.

Actual POST dispatches count toward 30, including failures. Output is capped at
4096 tokens, prompts at 48000 UTF8 bytes without truncation, and calls at 60 seconds.
The byte ceiling is a planning bound, not proof of exact tokenizer length.
The outer process deadline is 30 minutes and memory ceiling is 1 GiB.
Canonical CostTracker admission and reported/conservative failed-attempt accounting
enforce the shared $3 cap across resumed phases. No fallback or tools are permitted.

OpenRouter uses the existing Distill SecretStr key without displaying it. The
public catalog must still report $2 input and $10 output per million tokens for
anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5. Catalog and registry price admission establish a price
ceiling, not universal quality or factual accuracy. Preserve returned model,
upstream provider, usage source, billed cost, errors and limitations. No raw
thinking traces, authorization headers, or keys belong in receipts.

Cloud supports text only here. Submit only reviewed public/synthetic fixture text
and public repository snippets, never private payloads or another product corpus.
The local-only image contract is unchanged. No installs, downloads, source fetches,
web/tool model calls or automatic issue publication are authorized by these scripts.
